Open the local SQLite account/session store.

Source: R/curation_auth.R
curation_auth_open.Rd

The path must be a file outside the corpus cache and protected workspace data root. No account or secret is created by this operation.

Usage

curation_auth_open(
  path,
  busy_timeout = 5000L,
  max_failures = 5L,
  global_max_failures = 20L,
  failure_window = 300L,
  block_seconds = 300L,
  session_ttl = 43200L,
  idle_timeout = 3600L
)

Arguments

path

Explicit local SQLite path for accounts and sessions.

busy_timeout

Bounded SQLite busy timeout in milliseconds.

max_failures

Failed attempts allowed in one rate-limit window.

global_max_failures

Failed attempts allowed in the persistent global rate-limit bucket. Unknown usernames use this bucket without creating unbounded per-name rows.

failure_window

Rate-limit window in seconds.

block_seconds

Block duration after the failure threshold.

session_ttl

Absolute session lifetime in seconds.

idle_timeout

Maximum idle session lifetime in seconds.

Value

A planscanR_curation_auth store with a close() method.
